elements.name: loginButton

strategies.note: Element is an <input type=submit value=Login>; 'label' query matches on the value attribute acting as accessible name, not a <label> tag.
Only one button on the page, so role alone is unambiguous today -- but brittle if more buttons are added later.

primary.note: Recommend pairing role with accessible name 'Login' in Playwright (getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' })) for resilience even though role alone currently resolves to 1.

elements.gap_note: MEDIUM: data-test attribute (data-test='login-button') is present on the real DOM per known SauceDemo markup, but vibium's testid locator strategy only checks data-testid and returned 0 matches for testid=login-button. Same applies to data-test='username' and data-test='password' on the inputs (testid=username / testid=password both timed out). Downstream tests should NOT rely on getByTestId() here; use role/placeholder locators instead, or a documented CSS fallback like [data-test='login-button'] if the framework supports custom testid attribute config.
